title: Yehudah the Butcher
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot, under the entry Rabbi Meir, cites from a small book of stories a terrible tale of what happened to Rabbi Meir with the wife of Yehudah the butcher. Hyman rebukes the author of Seder HaDorot: “It would have been better for our master not to have written this falsehood.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Seder HaDorot paragraph contains the Meir and Yehudah the butcher narrative and credits a small book at its close. Hyman’s emphatic rejection of that story as a falsehood is preserved. The narrative’s presence in that source does not establish its historical truth.
